name: gmor45-bootstrap
description: Pointer skills that load Gmor45's operating rules and Gartera-Vault procedures from their private repos at session start. Public so it can be synced; carries none of the content itself.

plugins.name: load-house-rules
plugins.description: Fetches the operating rules from the private claude-audit repo at the start of any session, installs a Stop hook that refuses to end a substantive turn without a plain-English closing block (What I did / Why / Recommendations / TLDR), and adds /wherewasi, which reports what every running Claude Code chat is doing in plain English. Contains no rules itself.

plugins.name: gmor45-skills
plugins.description: Pointer skills for Gartera-Vault work (gartera-connect, gartera, flow, full-dive) that clone the private Gartera-Vault repo and read the real procedure live at session start. Contains none of the vault's content itself.
